notes: Irregular ground (Glen Park / Fowler Ave): the diagonal street (2140,2450)-(2340,2580) cutting blocks into triangles, a trapezoid and triangle split by a diagonal road at the top-left, a white block (2594*) wrapped by an L-shaped hatched block, unsubdivided hatched land west of Fowler Ave, and a curved block at the bottom. HOW DRAWN: one seed per block, street seeds in every street stretch, including the east-west streets of the east column (x 2310-2340), which are closed at their west ends. Strokes on printed lines or across the closing lines: small marks/lettering at street ends joined blocks above and below, cut with short strokes across the street end (Fowler side 1763-1777 at y 2457, 1765-1781 at y 2624; east column 2262-2280 at y 2384, 2268-2288 at y 2664; lettering in street mouths x 1888-1906 at y 2732 and 2789, 2010-2030 at y 2785, 2130-2150 at y 2782, 2240-2270 at y 2777). Lines printed straight across a street joined the blocks on both sides; each is cut in the middle of the street: (1898,2290-2303), (2022,2397-2409), (2140,2373-2388), (2141,2458-2490), (2018,2267-2281), (2257,2228-2238) at the box top, (2034,2842-2853) where the line closes the street between x 2029-2038 at the bottom (street seed added below it), and blobs at (2151,2818-2834), (2272,2815-2830); (2255-2270,2833) closes a street end. Gaps closed: top edge of block at (2061-2070,2790); top-left corner of the hatched land west of Fowler (1724-1736,2273); a tick across the road joining the triangle to the land north of the road cut at (1788-1804,2270). Block 2594* (2043-2105, 2230-2310) shares its outline with three blocks: strokes 2 px inside the neighbours keep its line with it: narrow block west of it (2040-2042, 2229-2279), small block east of it (2103-2107, 2229-2276), L-shaped hatched block around its foot ((2045,2285)-(2045,2315)-(2107,2309)-(2109,2302)-(2109,2281)). FOR THE OWNER TO RULE ON: (1) Hatched land west of Fowler Ave (x 1700-1757) has no block outline or number in the box: marked open. A thin line inside it (about x 1740) is read as nothing. (2) White land north of the road along the top (x 1700-1960, y 2230-2265, with a black rounded mark at 1765-1775, 2238-2258) has no outline of its own: marked open. (3) The narrow white outlined strip (2024-2045, 2235-2275) and the white outlined rectangle (2101-2132, 2232-2272) beside block 2594* carry no number: each read as its own block. The paper strips between them and the L-shaped block (y 2275-2288 and 2272-2284) read as dead-end street stubs. (4) Paper between two road lines at the top (around 1952,2236) is closed off by the box: left unseeded, so street. (5) The lettering of street names lies on block edges in places (e.g. Twenty-eighth at 1915-1960, 2381-2392; Chenery at 2200-2215, 2490-2502), leaving pockets of a few px of street-labelled paper inside the lettering.
